notes.text: What does God challenge Job to do, in order to prove he could save himself? (40:10-14) - Adorn himself with majesty, splendor, glory and beauty - Humble those who are proud

quotes.text: Then the Lord challenged Job to deck himself with majesty, forget his former anger, and deal out justice to "every one that is proud" and "abase him." If he could do it, the Lord would confess that Job could also save himself (Job 40:10-14).
